items.title: CVE-2026-123903: VMware authentication bypass in directory service (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. VMware vCenter Server, along with VMware Cloud Foundation and the Telco Cloud Platform and Infrastructure products, has a flaw in the VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in or any user interaction, and could give an attacker full control over the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-137974
items.summary: A flaw was found in tuned. This vulnerability allows local privilege escalation because the spindown-disk profile script does not properly validate filesystem mount sources before executing remount operations with root privileges. A local user capable of creating user-space filesystems can craft a malicious mount entry to execute arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-138034
items.summary: bigcommerce-api-mcp before 1.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to invoke MCP tools because the /sse and /messages routes skip the authenticateRequest middleware. Attackers can open /sse to obtain a session id and POST JSON-RPC tool calls to /messages to retrieve store product, order and customer records using the operator's BigCommerce API key.

items.title: CVE-2026-136115

items.title: CVE-2026-137898
items.summary: A flaw was found in pam. When built with libeconf and an unconfigured vendor directory, the pam_econf configuration handler misinterprets the search path, causing it to look for configuration files in a relative directory within the current working directory. A local attacker can exploit this by placing crafted environment configuration files in a world-writable location. If an administrator executes a privileged command from that directory, the malicious variables are loaded into the privileged process, resulting in local privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-138026
items.summary: Crypto APIs MCP server packages (@cryptoapis-io/mcp-*) before 0.4.0, mcp-blockchain-events, mcp-blockchain-fees, mcp-broadcast and mcp-prepare-transactions before 0.5.0, and mcp-aml before 0.2.0 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to invoke tools using the operator's API key. When started with Streamable HTTP transport and --api-key, the server binds 0.0.0.0 and exposes /mcp, letting attackers consume paid credits, read account data, redirect event subscriptions, and delete HD wallet xPubs.

items.title: CVE-2026-137970
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ssrf-protection.ts that fails to classify NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48) and 6to4 (2002::/16) IPv6 addresses embedding internal IPv4. Authenticated users can set REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth data-source URLs to attacker hostnames whose AAAA records resolve to these forms, bypassing pre-request and dial-time guards to reach cloud metadata and internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137969
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery protection bypass because getSSRFProtectionOptions passes its safe resolver as dnsLookup instead of lookup. Attackers controlling datasource hostnames can use DNS rebinding in REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth requests to reach blocked private addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-136113

items.title: CVE-2026-134129
items.summary: smalot/pdfparser before 2.14.0 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service by submitting a crafted PDF with deeply nested unbalanced parentheses in a content-stream string. Attackers can exploit the regex-based string isolation loop in PDFObject::formatContent(), which rescans growing content on each pass to produce O(n^2) processing time, causing a small PDF to stall or exhaust PHP worker resources for seconds to minutes.

items.title: CVE-2026-138048
items.summary: ntfy before v2.38.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the web push endpoint allow-list by crafting a URL containing '#' or '?' characters that satisfy the [^/]+ regex pattern used to validate mozaws.net and notify.windows.com hosts. Attackers can submit an endpoint .example#.mozaws.net/push, which passes validation while Go parses the actual host as attacker.example, causing the server to send subsequent web push POST requests to an attacker-controlled or internal host.

items.title: CVE-2026-138033
items.summary: mcp-video-analyzer 0.2.0 before 0.10.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to reach internal addresses by supplying any http(s) URL ending in a video extension. Attackers can use prompt injection to make tools like get_frames fetch loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses directly or via redirects, writing responses to disk or returning rendered screenshots.

items.title: CVE-2026-138029
items.summary: Wazuh-MCP-Server before commit 2bbfe12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the blueteam_check_webshell tool because WebshellCheckInput.validate_url accepts DNS hostnames without resolving them. Attackers can supply URLs whose hostnames resolve or redirect to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, making curl reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints and leak response details.

items.title: CVE-2026-138028
items.summary: Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 contains an argument injection vulnerability in RsyncFilesToLocalDirectory that allows attackers to inject rsync options because only --quiet and --log-format values are rejected. Attackers who influence the LLM through prompt-injected content can trigger run_pipeline with -e/--rsh or --rsync-path options to execute commands as the Bagel server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-107967
items.summary: HCL Verse for Android included a decryption code for compatibility with locally stored values and attachment files created by older application versions (no longer used for data stored by newer versions). HCL Verse for Android version 14.5.16 (November 2026) removed the legacy decryption code.

items.title: CVE-2026-81053
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132876
items.summary: Dreamweaver Desktop is affected by a Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control and requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file. Scope is changed.

items.title: CVE-2026-137979
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the Nmap Scripting Engine because nse_main.lua does not explicitly seed Lua's math.random generator. Malicious scanned hosts can observe math.random-derived values in NSE script traffic during -sC scans, brute-force the seed, and recover a heap address that weakens ASLR.

items.title: CVE-2026-137978
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::process_request in libnetutil/massdns.cc that frees still-referenced requests when rescheduling after DNS server disconnects. Attackers answering for at least two configured DNS servers can force a disconnect and send a precisely timed response to crash the scan, possibly enabling code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137965
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with the TEST_CONNECTION ability to reach arbitrary hosts by supplying body-controlled datasource options. Attackers can set kind, plugin_id, and host options for plugins like influxdb or elasticsearch to reach loopback, internal services, or cloud metadata endpoints exposing IAM credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-137960
items.summary: Budibase backend-core before 3.49.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated Builder/Creator users to bypass the outbound-fetch deny list by targeting the IPv6 unspecified address. Attackers can supply URLs with host [::] to features like Outgoing Webhook or REST datasources to reach IPv6 loopback services and read reflected internal responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-137957
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in integration nodes that build API request paths from unencoded record, table, or resource ID parameters. Attackers can supply relative path segments through untrusted input such as webhook bodies to read, modify, or delete unintended resources using the node's stored credential.

items.title: CVE-2026-137952
items.summary: svglib before 2.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in SvgRenderer.renderNode() that recursively renders internal href fragment references without expansion limits or cycle detection. Attackers can supply crafted SVGs to svg2rlg() with nested groups referencing each other twice or self-referencing images to cause exponential resource consumption or RecursionError crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-81055
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Observable Timing Discrepancy vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Session theft.

items.title: CVE-2026-81054
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137941
items.summary: A flaw was found in GIMP. The Levels configuration setter does not validate the channel enum before using it to index fixed-size per-channel arrays. A crafted XCF file with a non-destructive Levels filter can set an out-of-range channel (LUMINANCE or RGB), causing a heap out-of-bounds read and write when the file is opened. This may lead to a crash or arbitrary code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-81044
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. items.title: CVE-2026-81042
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-81041
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service and Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137999
items.summary: JSONSchema2PoPo2 through 3.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject Python code by supplying JSON Schema default or format values that are written unescaped. Attackers can place a single quote in a string property default to break out of the literal in the generated __init__ signature, executing injected code when the generated module is imported.

items.title: CVE-2026-137998
items.summary: Detoxify 0.5.3 through 0.5.4 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_checkpoint that allows attackers to execute code by supplying a crafted checkpoint file. Attackers can embed a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a .ckpt file loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False to run code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137997
items.summary: HCIPy through 0.7.1 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .pkl files to read_field, read_grid or read_mode_basis. Because hcipy/util/io.py selects pickle by file extension and calls pickle.load, a __reduce__ gadget in a pupil, apodizer, PSF or mode-basis file runs code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137994
items.summary: Leo through 6.8.10 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by embedding pickled data in unknown XML attributes of .leo outlines. Attackers can place a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a or element attribute that resolveUa passes to pickle.loads, executing code with user privileges when the outline is opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-137992
items.summary: libexpat through 2.11.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in defineAttribute() of lib/xmlparse.c that fails to detect duplicate non-ID #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED attribute declarations. Attackers can supply a crafted XML document with repeated ATTLIST declarations in an internal DTD subset to cause quadratic CPU consumption in storeAtts() during parsing.

items.title: CVE-2026-81040
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability. items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.9.1.

items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.9.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-137977
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::handle_write in libnetutil/massdns.cc that dereferences freed request objects after writes complete. Attackers controlling or on-path to a DNS server can send timed DNS responses with forged ICMP port-unreachable messages to crash scans, disclose memory, or hijack execution.

On a device that is both an SMP server (for example over Bluetooth LE or UDP) and an SM…

items.title: CVE-2026-80509
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Script injection.

items.title: CVE-2026-80501
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-80504
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') vulnerability. items.title: CVE-2026-137973
items.summary: Heym from 0.0.95 before 0.0.154 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to run script on the application origin by publishing HTML output mapper workflows. Attackers can set a workflow to anonymous GET and share the /api/workflows/{id}/execute link, causing visitors' browsers to send authenticated API requests to read or modify their workflows, credentials, and settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-137972
items.summary: Heym before 0.0.154 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the workflow execute endpoint: anonymous workflows run as any signed-in caller, without an access check, using that caller's credentials and global variables. Authenticated attackers can lure signed-in users to a GET execute link for an attacker-owned anonymous workflow, which the SameSite=Lax session cookie authenticates. The attacker then reads the victim's decrypted credentials from the workflow's run history.

items.title: CVE-2026-137967
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server fetch internal URLs via the gRPC v2 proto_file_url option. Attackers can target loopback, private, cloud metadata, or redirect-controlled addresses, or serve oversized responses that are buffered and parsed synchronously, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137966
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an arbitrary file read and SSRF vulnerability in the SMTP plugin that allows authenticated app builders to pass object values to Nodemailer. Attackers can set textContent or htmlContent to path or href content objects to email server files or internal cloud metadata responses to themselves.

items.title: CVE-2026-137964
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137962
items.summary: Budibase server before 3.48.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public API view row search endpoint that skips per-view permission checks due to a tableId/viewId parameter mismatch. items.summary: Flowintel contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its HedgeDoc case-notes integration. Before the fix, the stored URL was used directly without validation of its scheme, host, port, path, or userinfo, and the HTTP client followed redirects by default with no connect or read timeouts. An authenticated attacker could therefore cause the Flowintel server to issue requests to arbitrary int…

items.title: CVE-2026-137911
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137910
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137909
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137908
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-137905

Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-85567
items.summary: Setting an empty API key was not properly disabling access to the internal HTTP API, despite being documented as such. This allowed an attacker whose IP address was allowed by the webserver ACL to bypass the authentication and get read-only access to the API.

items.title: CVE-2026-85563
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DNS over HTTPS GET queries with a body. DNSdist should either refuse the query or ignore the HTTP body, but instead was processing the content of the HTTP body rather than the query present in the HTTP path.

items.title: CVE-2026-85562
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not replace existing X-Forwarded-For headers but merely append a new header to the query, the first header was used by DNSdist instead of the last one, making it possible for a client to spoof its own IP address.

items.title: CVE-2026-85561
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled between DNSdist and one of its backends, an outgoing TCP connection could be wrongly reused for a query received over the same incoming DNS over HTTPS connection but with a different X-Forwarded-For header, causing the backend to consider the query as coming from the same remote client than the first query received on the outgoing connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-123756
items.summary: An attacker can cause a denial of service by sending crafted HTTP queries to the internal webserver. The webserver is not enabled by default and is protected by an ACL.

items.title: CVE-2026-123755
items.summary: An attacker allowed to send AXFR or IXFR queries can cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to be stuck, causing a denial of service to other clients trying to reuse the same outgoing connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-85565
items.summary: An attacker can trigger a synchronization issue on outgoing TCP connections between DNSdist and its backend by sending oversized DNS over HTTPS queries. This could cause the backend to refuse queries, send a server failure, or just close the TCP connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-85564
items.summary: An attacker can trigger a large memory use by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving the response from its backend. Instead of releasing the memory corresponding to the cancelled stream right away, DNSdist was mistakenly keeping it around until the end of the QUIC connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-137609
items.summary: In Eclipse Krazo Extensions up to and including 3.0.0, AsciiDocViewEngine passes MVC model values to Asciidoctor as document attributes without encoding them. Asciidoctor substitutes attribute references after it escapes HTML special characters and before it processes inline macros. As a result, attacker-controlled model values end up in the output as raw HTML and can inject AsciiDoc inline macros. This allows cross-site scripting in applications that render untrusted data through AsciiDoc views.

items.title: CVE-2026-133845
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal. When a sandboxed application invokes Spawn() and maps two different file descriptors to the same handle, dup2() can fail. Affected Flatpak versions do not handle that failure, so a file descriptor that was open inside flatpak-portal (commonly the unfiltered D-Bus session bus) can be passed into the subsandbox. A malicious or compromised Flatpak app with no special privileges can use this to escape the sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-133842
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper. When a system-wide app, runtime, or extension uses the extra-data mechanism and its apply_extra logic creates a deeply nested directory tree, permission canonicalization can fail (for example with EMFILE). Affected Flatpak versions can still report success without clearing setuid/setgid bits, leaving a setuid-root executable under /var/lib/flatpak. A local attacker who can install or update such content system-wide, or who can already execute code as a local user in cooperation with that content, can escalate privileges to root.

items.title: CVE-2026-132890
items.summary: In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1.0.0-RC2 through 1.0.0-RC7, the HashiCorp Vault extension does not reject .. path segments in secret aliases. In a multi-participant (virtual) control plane where vault partitions share the runtime's Vault token, an authenticated participant can set a callback secret alias that escapes its own vault partition. The connector then reads secrets of other participants or of the runtime, such as STS client secrets or the encryption key, and sends them to an endpoint the attacker chooses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115841
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. DSA signature verification does not reject a public key with generator 1 and public value 1 before calling the cryptographic backend. Upstream reports that the Nettle and OpenSSL backends, including the default Nettle build, accept this key. Under that key, a signature can verify for every message. Ordinary DSA keys are not affected. An application is exposed when that degenerate certificate is accepted as authoritative.

items.title: CVE-2026-115836
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The default ASCII-armor parser accepts Unicode dash characters in armor framing and ignores leading quote characters. A crafted byte stream can be parsed as one message by this tolerant parser and as a different message by a strict ASCII-armor parser. The strict mode is opt-in; the default parser remains tolerant.

items.title: CVE-2026-115835
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The ASCII-armor reader does not limit the length of a line. Parsing an armored message with a very long line can exhaust memory in the process. Memory use follows the input size, with a small constant factor, and is not a classic amplification.

items.title: CVE-2026-115834

items.title: CVE-2026-95622
items.summary: A flaw was found in ModemManager. When parsing a Cell Broadcast Message, some 3GPP data-coding-scheme values (8-bit and reserved character sets) are not handled. items.title: Large AI-Generated Image PNG Upload Timeout: Node.js Multipart vs Single PUT
items.summary: Use multipart upload for large AI-generated images or batches when a single PUT starts timing out; keep single PUT for files that finish reliably. The deciding constraint is not PNG versus WebP. It is whether a failed request forces the entire artifact across the network again. That choice solves only transport. A media training pipeline also needs a reproducible rule for retention and deletion. Persist multipart state in the application database, resume finished parts after a retry, and make every terminal path call either complete or abort. Lifecycle policy is a backstop measured in days, no…

The ships were named Indiana (pictured) , Massachusetts and Oregon , and all three served in the Spanish–American War . After the war, Oregon returned to the Pacific and participated in the Philippine–American War and the suppression of the Boxer Rebellion . items.summary: A flaw was found in the Linux kernel's vDPA vHost Data Path Acceleration block simulator driver. Due to improper input validation, the driver logs out-of-range starting sector requests but fails to reject them, causing an arithmetic underflow and an invalid buffer offset. An attacker with access to the simulated device, such as a guest virtual machine, can submit a crafted storage request to trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes in the host kernel. This flaw may result in a system crash leading to a denial of service, information disclosure, or arbitrary code execution...
